seo.description: Complete guide to COVID-19 RT-PCR test in India. Learn preparation, procedure, normal values, and what results mean.

overview: COVID-19 RT-PCR is a commonly ordered diagnostic test used to evaluate specific aspects of your health.
preparation: Follow fasting instructions if required (typically 8-12 hours)
procedure: Blood/urine sample collection at certified lab
normalRange: Reference ranges vary by lab, age, and gender. Always interpret with your doctor.
interpretation: Compare with previous results for trends
Single abnormal value may not indicate disease
Doctor will correlate with symptoms and examination

faqs.question: Do I need to fast for COVID-19 RT-PCR?
faqs.answer: Check specific test requirements. Fasting tests typically need 8-12 hours.

faqs.question: How long for COVID-19 RT-PCR results?
faqs.answer: Most results available within 24-48 hours at standard labs.
